clauses.scope_note: Section 7.2; applies to Aliyun or affiliate marks, service marks, URLs, text, service names, and combinations, including combined or derivative forms.
clauses.condition_explanation: written_permission_from_aliyun_or_its_affiliate means the relevant owner has given written permission. Authorized use must follow that entity's then-current specifications.

obligation_items.content: Do not display or use the identified marks, seek trademark or domain-name registration for them, or represent or imply authority to display, use, or otherwise handle them.
obligation_items.object: Aliyun or affiliate marks, service marks, URLs, text, service names, and combinations
obligation_items.trigger: Unless written permission has been obtained from Aliyun or its affiliate.

clauses.scope_note: Section 7.2; use of the identified Aliyun or affiliate marks after written authorization.
clauses.condition_explanation: written_permission_from_aliyun_or_its_affiliate means written authorization by Aliyun or its affiliate. follow_licensor_specifications means use strictly follows the specifications imposed by the authorizing entity at that time.

obligation_items.content: Use the authorized marks strictly in accordance with the specifications imposed by the authorizing entity.
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever the licensee uses marks under written authorization.

clauses.scope_note: Section 7.3 concerns intellectual-property ownership of a model optimized, debugged, trained, or fine-tuned through the service. It defers allocation to service documentation, website announcements, or third-party model-provider license terms and does not itself state the allocation.
clauses.condition_explanation: If those external terms do not specify ownership, the parties may contact Aliyun or the third-party provider to negotiate; the result is not stated here.

clauses.scope_note: Section 7.4; concerns materials, assets, audio, and video uploaded by the licensee and their use in the service.
clauses.condition_explanation: licensee_owns_or_has_authorization_for_uploaded_materials means the licensee owns the relevant intellectual-property rights or has authorization from the lawful rights holder. use_has_no_actual_or_potential_dispute means neither the material nor its use is subject to an actual or potential dispute.

obligation_items.content: Ensure intellectual-property rights in uploaded materials, assets, audio, and video are owned by the licensee or authorized by the lawful rights holder, and that the material and its use are free of actual or potential disputes.
obligation_items.object: Materials, assets, audio, and video uploaded to the service and their use
obligation_items.trigger: Throughout service use involving uploaded materials.

clauses.scope_note: Section 7.4; both the user and Aliyun have responsibilities when a third party questions or complains about intellectual-property ownership in relevant materials or the service used.
clauses.condition_explanation: third_party_questions_or_complains_about_ip_ownership_of_materials_or_service_used means a third party raises such a question or complaint.

obligation_items.content: Provide relevant intellectual-property proof materials and cooperate with the other party in handling the complaint.
obligation_items.actor: licensee and Aliyun, each toward the other
obligation_items.object: Proof materials concerning the challenged materials or service
obligation_items.trigger: When a third party questions or complains about intellectual-property ownership in materials used with the service or in the service itself.

clauses.scope_note: Section 7.5; conditional ownership allocation for synthetic content produced using models provided by Aliyun or its affiliates on the Bailian platform. It does not independently grant rights to use, distribute, or commercialize the output.
clauses.condition_explanation: The stated allocation applies where the user has lawful intellectual-property rights in uploaded content, subject to another agreement or applicable law. The user must independently judge and handle whether the synthetic content has intellectual-property rights and their allocation.

clauses.scope_note: Section 7.6; concerns external commercial use of generated information and the legality of inputs and outputs by the user and downstream customers. It is not a blanket noncommercial restriction.
clauses.condition_explanation: The clause highlights increased infringement risk where inputs contain unauthorized text or well-known IP, or where the referenced section 4.3.4 network-search requirement is not followed. Section 4.3.4 is not supplied in this target chunk.

obligation_items.content: Ensure inputs and outputs are used lawfully and reasonably.
obligation_items.actor: licensee and its downstream customers, each for its own input and output conduct
obligation_items.object: Inputs and outputs involved in use of the service and external commercialization of generated content
obligation_items.trigger: When using inputs or outputs, including when externally commercializing generated content; the clause specifically flags unauthorized text, well-known IP, and failure to comply with referenced section 4.3.4 as heightened-risk circumstances.

clauses.scope_note: Section 7.7; waiver concerning claims against Aliyun and other customers where another customer receives similar AI-generated content. This is not an ownership grant or general output-use permission.
clauses.condition_explanation: other_aliyun_customer_receives_similar_generated_content means another customer obtains similar AI-generated content through Bailian.

obligation_items.content: Do not bring a claim against Aliyun or another customer based on the described similarity of generated content.
obligation_items.object: Claims against Aliyun or other customers concerning similar AI-generated content
obligation_items.trigger: When another Aliyun customer obtains similar AI-generated content through Bailian.

clauses.scope_note: Section 8.1 defines material covered by confidentiality duties; it is contextual and imposes no behavioral restriction by itself.
clauses.condition_explanation: The definition includes business secrets, technical secrets, know-how, and other information requiring confidentiality obtained from or arising through performance of the agreement, including listed business, customer, technical, and software information, regardless of medium or whether marked confidential.

clauses.scope_note: Section 8.2; applies mutually to confidential information provided by the other party, subject to section 8.4 exceptions.
clauses.condition_explanation: recipient_holds_other_party_confidential_information means a party has received or holds the other party's confidential information. agreement_related_purpose means a purpose related to the agreement.

obligation_items.content: Use the other party's confidential information only for purposes related to the agreement.
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever the recipient uses confidential information, except to the extent a section 8.4 exception applies.

obligation_items.content: Take appropriate measures to protect the other party's confidential information with care no less than that used to protect the recipient's own confidential information.
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever the recipient holds or safeguards confidential information, except to the extent a section 8.4 exception applies.

clauses.scope_note: Section 8.3; applies mutually to the parties' confidential information, subject to section 8.4 exceptions.
clauses.condition_explanation: The recipient must strictly limit access to personnel responsible for the relevant business and employees, and ensure employees with access comply with confidentiality obligations.

obligation_items.content: Limit knowledge of confidential information to personnel responsible for the relevant business and employees, and strictly require employees given access to comply with the confidentiality obligation.
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever the recipient holds confidential information, except to the extent a section 8.4 exception applies.

clauses.scope_note: Sections 8.4–8.4.7; exceptions to confidentiality restrictions in sections 8.2–8.3, not an unrestricted license. The qualification/certification disclosure path has additional conditions.
clauses.condition_explanation: The listed alternatives are disjunctive. They cover information lawfully owned before the agreement; information already public when disclosed; receipt from a third party without confidentiality or nondisclosure duties; later public availability without breach; independent development without benefit from the discloser's information; disclosure required by a court or legal or administrative process; or necessary disclosure for qualification, recognition, or standards/certification, with minimum disclosure and protection by the recipient institution to at least the agreement's standard.

obligation_items.content: For a disclosure made to obtain a business qualification, recognition, or compliance with a national or industry standard or certification, disclose only the minimum necessary and require the receiving institution to protect the information to a standard no lower than this agreement.
obligation_items.object: Other party's confidential information submitted to an authority, industry association, or similar institution
obligation_items.trigger: Only when disclosure is needed for the stated qualification, recognition, or standard/certification purpose.

clauses.scope_note: Section 8.5; mutual duties to protect confidential information and respond to discovered leakage.
clauses.condition_explanation: confidential_information_leak_is_discovered means either party discovers a leakage event involving covered confidential information. The protection duty is ongoing; cooperation is triggered by discovery.

obligation_items.content: Use best efforts to protect confidential information from leakage and, upon discovering a leakage event, cooperate in taking all reasonable measures to avoid or mitigate resulting harm.
obligation_items.object: Confidential information and the consequences of its leakage
obligation_items.trigger: Protection is ongoing; cooperation is required upon discovery of a leakage event.

clauses.scope_note: Section 9.1; gives Aliyun discretionary enforcement options, including limiting or suspending use or terminating service or the agreement.
clauses.condition_explanation: Triggers are alternatives: breach of a stated commitment, warranty, service-use rule, or obligation, or Aliyun's independent judgment that use is abnormal. Remedies may be combined.

clauses.scope_note: Section 9.4; termination option for an Aliyun-caused continuous 72-hour inability to use the service; excludes causes outside Aliyun's control.
clauses.condition_explanation: aliyun_cause means the cause is attributable to Aliyun. The right does not apply to causes outside Aliyun's control.

clauses.scope_note: Section 10.1; contact information supplied to Aliyun or its affiliates for service use, including email, telephone, and address. The account used for in-site and system messages, including subaccounts, is also a valid contact method.
clauses.condition_explanation: Contact details must be true, effective, current, and reachable while the licensee uses the service.

obligation_items.content: Provide true and effective contact information, promptly update changed information, and remain contactable.
obligation_items.object: Contact details supplied to Aliyun or its affiliates, including email address, telephone number, address, and applicable account contact
obligation_items.trigger: When using the service and whenever contact information changes.

clauses.scope_note: Section 10.4; reiterates accuracy, effectiveness, and real-time updating of contact information and allocates consequences of inaccurate or outdated details.
clauses.condition_explanation: The stated consequence applies if inaccurate information or failure to report changed details prevents or delays service of legal documents.

obligation_items.content: Ensure supplied contact details are accurate and effective and update them in real time.
obligation_items.object: Contact information supplied for notices and legal documents
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever contact information is supplied or changes.

coverage_notes: Section 7.3 defers fine-tuned-model intellectual-property allocation to absent service documentation, announcements, or third-party terms; no allocation is inferred. Section 7.4 also allocates responsibility for claims, litigation, costs, losses, and indemnification, which is not represented as an activity permission or restriction.

Section 7.5 states a conditional ownership allocation for synthetic content but leaves the existence and handling of rights to the user. Section 7.6 includes compensation for losses to Aliyun or affiliates; this is not modeled as a charge or license permission. The section 4.3.4 cross-reference is unavailable in the target chunk.

Sections 9.2, 9.5, 9.7, and 9.8 concern compensation, responsibility, or liability limitations. Sections 9.3 and 9.6 are disclaimers; sections 10.2–10.3 concern notice delivery mechanics; sections 11–13 concern force majeure and legal boilerplate. These are not converted into artificial use rules.
No operational facts establish whether any condition has been met or any duty performed.

paragraph_audit.reason: The paragraph's mark restrictions, uploaded-material rights assurance, complaint cooperation, generated-content ownership terms, lawful input/output duties, similarity-claim waiver, confidentiality duties and exceptions, leakage response, discretionary enforcement, termination option, and contact-information duties are modeled. Claims/cost/indemnity allocation and absent external ownership terms and cross-referenced requirements remain incompletely representable or unavailable, so the paragraph is UNRESOLVED.
